Zephyrhills · 2026-11-23 · City Council Meeting (City Council): 41-22-12C - InfoTect Extension
item.description: The City of Zephyrhills has contracted with Infotect Design Solutions since 2000 on a variety of information technology services. In 2022, Council approved a piggyback agreement with the Tampa-Hillsborough Expressway Authority for Infotect to provide general information technology support services to the City’s IT department consisting of a 3 year agreement valid thru November 31st 2024 followed by 2 optional 1 year agreements. On September 8th, 2026, Tampa-Hillsborough Expressway Authority approved an amendment to the original contract extending services thru July 21st, 2027. Staff recommends approval extending the Piggyback Extension Agreement for an additional 3 months while we seek an RFQ.

item.title: Zephyrhills · 2026-11-09 · City Council (City Council): Public access to City's Mapping Program presentation
item.description: The City has been making improvements to its Geographic Information Systems (GIS) to enhance public access to information and improve communication with the community. A new public-facing website is being developed to share project updates, news, and GIS resources. Additionally, a public zoning map is being published to allow residents and businesses to easily view zoning classifications, city limits, and other relevant geographic information. These improvements are intended to increase transparency, streamline access to information, and support a more business-friendly environment by making it easier for prospective businesses, developers, and residents to navigate the City's planning and development processes.

item.title: Zephyrhills · 2026-07-27 · City Council Meeting (City Council): Multi-Use Trail Planning Update
item.description: Planning staff continues to work closely with the Community Redevelopment Agency (CRA) to develop a citywide multi-use trail network that will improve connectivity while supporting recreation, alternative transportation, and economic development. The proposed trail system is envisioned as a central spine through the core of the community, connecting neighborhoods, parks, schools, downtown, recreational facilities, and other key destinations.
